blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) is allocating P30 million for cloud seeding operations in the Visayas to mitigate the effects of the super El Niño, Manuel Lamata, president of the United Sugar Producers Federation, said Friday, Oct. 30. Lamata, in a press statement, said he received a letter from SRA Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona dated October 26, confirming that SRA has already set aside the budget for cloud seeding operations particularly in Negros Island and Panay. “We are thankful to Administrator Azcona for proactively addressing our concerns and we are hoping that the budget is […]...
